author: Sylin Labs
name: Koan Review Queue API
description: A Koan web API with human-in-the-loop review of AI output: a typed review queue over an IReviewable Entity via AddKoanReview, approve/reject/edit/label/flag decisions through IReviewActionHandler persisted over SQLite. Runs its proof journey on startup.

manualInstructions.text:
Run it:
  dotnet run

The startup journey prints PROBE PASS after proving queue registration, approve/reject persistence, and duplicate-name refusal.

Wire your own generation pipeline to save entities as Pending, then expose an authorized endpoint that calls handler.ApproveAsync / RejectAsync and saves.

Working with a coding agent:
  AGENTS.md orients any agent to this application and to Koan's capability map.
